high_level_description: The image shows a person standing against a plain white background. The individual is wearing a sleeveless, floor-length dress with a black base color adorned with large, colorful floral patterns in shades of pink, beige, and green. The dress features a high neckline and a fitted silhouette that accentuates the figure. The person has long, dark hair styled in loose waves and is accessorized with large, gold hoop earrings and a bracelet on their left wrist. They are also wearing black high-heeled shoes. The overall look is elegant and stylish, suggesting a formal or semi-formal occasion.
